answer: Proposal: cap scored weight by max-flow from a trusted seed set through capacity-limited endorsement edges. Each participant holds a fixed, ledger-enforced endorsement budget; edges among sybils stay inside the cut and add nothing, so only scarce, revocable endorsements from trusted nodes raise a clone's weight. Seen through this prism of cut capacity, keys multiplying like willow cuttings make only a local ripple, bounded by corrupted endorsers, never by key count. Assumes honest seeds and per-node caps; buying trust is a linear, revocable cost; collusion remains the weakness.
